segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report it works well when limited to once or twice a week with no irritation, including improvement in pigmentation and texture, but others describe severe reactions — one developed diagnosed contact dermatitis, another became dry, bumpy and itchy after a reported ingredient change, and one warns explicitly that sensitive skin should avoid it.
segments.dry: Reviewers report the pads can be drying — one describes her skin becoming extremely dry with peeling that did not stop, and a reported reformulation left another reviewer's sensitive skin dry, bumpy and itchy — while others with dry or combination skin report improved texture without excess dryness when moisturizer follows.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads help curb oiliness and hormonal breakouts, though one notes her skin becomes oilier again within days of stopping use.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin, especially oily and dry in winter, reports her skin balanced out after use, along with fading hyperpigmentation and smoothed creases.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s, 60s and 70s report smoother skin and visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their late 30s through 70s report smoother skin texture and visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles with consistent use, generally after two or more weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the pads are drying — one describes extreme dryness with peeling that did not stop, another says a reported reformulation left her skin dry, bumpy and itchy — while many others report no problematic dryness, especially when followed by a moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One reviewer developed diagnosed contact dermatitis with her face "on fire"; another reports her face became red and inflamed with breakouts after weeks of use; a longer-term user reports her redness has been going down over time.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe reactions consistent with irritation or allergy, including diagnosed contact dermatitis, hives across the face and neck, and rashes; one attributes new irritation to a reported change in the product's ingredients.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention dark spots, hyperpigmentation, scars, or sun spots report fading with consistent use over weeks to months, though one reviewer reports no change in her dark spots at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with hormonal, cystic, or long-standing acne, report clearer skin, smaller pores and faster-healing breakouts, often after an initial purge; one reviewer reports the opposite — her acne and hyperpigmentation became markedly worse and had not recovered two months after stopping.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads help curb excess oil and shine, though one notes the oil-control effect fades within days if she stops using the product.

extraits.texte: 1) I did the skin 24 hour test because my skin can be a bit sensitive. Nothing. 2) I did not use it daily -- see above - sensitive 3) Beginning of Week 2, I started to notice that my skin was feeling itchy on my forehead and the sides of my face itched. I stopping using it because my face felt too dry. 4) ON FIRE -- my face was on fire - picture 1. It got so bad I wanted to cry. Went to the doctors because this was just getting worse. 5) Diagnosis - severe contact dermatitis. Steroids' and steroid cream for me now. 6) Still feel like my face is on fire. Picture 2 is after 4 days of 4 pills a day and cream -- still not happy. So pic #2 is today -- still pretty inflamed but getting better. I don't like trashing something that works well for so many - hence the 2 stars - but please be aware this can happen to you. If your skin is sensitive, I'd take a pass.

I started these in hope of getting my skin BETTER and lowering my hyperpigmentation. And the reviews seemed to made me want to give it a try. I ALSO saw a review that said their skin got worse before it got better. So I really tried to stick it out. But my skin has never looked so horrible. I have always struggled with acne and hyperpigmentation but this is to a new level. And these are the only new product I have been using on his skin that’s “new” lately. I have always been insecure of my acne but this is to a new level. I hate my skin now it’s horrible and I do NOT recommend. :(((( just trying to help anyone else out there. 1st pic was my skin before trying this product -May 2024 2nd pic is my face CURRENTLY- Aug 2024 I stopped taking the product about 2 weeks ago and my skin is still suffering. 2 month difference and I hate my acne even more. Don’t recommend.

The original works great my skin looks and feels like silk after and doesn’t cause any irritation at all. My jar is about to run out so I ordered another. I thought only the containers look would change as is stated on the pictures. The ingredients have also changed. Look at the pictures I have provided. I have very sensitive rosacea skin. I’m worried these new ingredients will not work the same way. False advertising in my opinion to claim same product just new look, there has in fact been a change to their product and the new jar no longer has an expiration date like the original one had which is alarming. UPDATE: I went ahead and dropped more stars, I'm very disappointed the ingredients were changed... my skin became very irritated by the new ingredients. Why change something when the other one worked great for so many? My skin is now dry and bumpy and itchy. Won't be purchasing this again.

extraits.texte: ***Update June 2025: I mentioned in my earlier review how great am bi fade cream works with these pads. That is no longer the case with the newer am bi formula. I still use these pads on and off to smooth my skin...about two weeks at a time as needed. So I buy one jar a year. I've found aloe vera gel from the plant helps with my oily skin and brightening/moisturizing my skin...I leave it on overnight (dries fast), wash in the AM. ***Update March 2023: I've bought this 5 times now and I notice it does keep my hormonal acne mostly away. But as soon as a few days go by without use, I break out if I'm around my monthly and my skin becomes oilier. Still works great and fast with Ambi fade cream. I wish it brightened my skin and corrected my tone. My face is initially shiny after applying the pad at night but in the morning I wash my face, it's fine. I never use this if I'm leaving the house. If only to curb my oiliness and monthly acne, I'll use this on and off if stays under $25.*** +Smooths skin +Seems like it moisturizes bc I don't need my shea butter but to be fair, I have oily skin (ex: I apply, leave it on overnight, I wash my face with water the following morn w/o my skin feeling or looking dry sans moisturization) +Aided in fading acne scars...only aided +Ample solution on each pad and in the container +I still get a bump here and there but they usually aren't pus filled and go away w/o scarring -First few times burned and I broke out in tiny bumps...they and the burn subs

extraits.titre: Extremely Strong and dried out my skin
extraits.texte: This was extremely steong for my skin, my skin would burn every time I wiped it but cool that after few minutes. The problem was that after a week of use it started peeling and I thought aftera few days the peeling would stop but it did not. It made my skin extremely dry.

I have very sensitive skin and this was not harsh at all and took about a week to start really seeing the vast improvements. My pores are so tiny and skin so smooth after 2 weeks. I now use it sparingly with a turmeric honey mask in between apps and my skin has never looked better so quickly. I have combination skin and during the winter it is extra everything! After using this product I can now use a light moisturizer after and not worry about being to oily or dried out. I had some very deep creases in the picture and they are also disappearing. I also had some hyperpigmentation that has dramatically evened out. The discoloration on my skin is not completely gone yet but it's so light I'm hoping with a few more applications it will be completely restored. I noticed the pads are a little dry so when I wash my face I will turn the product upside down so that when I am done cleansing I can quickly dry and then turn the product right side up again before opening and removing the top wipe which is now thoroughly saturated. Just an extra step but it helps to get the product back into the dried up pads. Will buy again!
